what: what the lost reach masks of the 1b closure (CliffBoundary308/plan/_work/reach_p1b_v6_{S0_wall_seam_kept,S2_wall_seam_kept,top_UP1}.npy) gave the map bake, carried from the bundle that was baked from them. NOT the masks: the masks cannot be made again (Docs/Handoff/Recovery308 M-3 / M-6).

regions.how: byte copy of the imported map308_reveal_regions.bytes (sha recorded in the notation above)

tops.how: numpy.packbits of a 1500 x 1000 mask of terrain cells, south row first: the cells whose G in the imported map308_terrain.png differs from a bake without cliff-top cells (all raised to the cliff-top density). Proof: the terrain baked with this mask is the imported PNG byte for byte
tops.limit: a cliff-top cell whose forest density was already at or above the cliff-top density left no trace and is not in the mask: it would show only if the trees on the cliff tops were taken away

regionNames.2: other cliff tops: raised > 3 m and reachable only after the gate

validWhile: the stage height and the base height have the sha above (the bake refuses otherwise)
exit: when cliff308_closure.py runs again for this height, map308_lib.STAGES goes back to reach= and these three files are taken out
